title: Murder In Melbourne
description: When Amarjeet Singh disappears after sending his wife Simran a cryptic message, Detective Shergil investigates. His search uncovers family secrets, illicit affairs, betrayal and a property dispute. When Amarjeet's body is found and Simran vanishes, the case turns darker. As suspects die and clues lead in different directions, Shergil must confront his past to catch the killer.
